descricao_original: The secondary follicle continues to grow, its multiple antral spaces coalescing into a single antrum. The primary oocyte remains arrested in prophase of the first meiotic division. It is surrounded by a ring of granulosal cells (the cumulus oophorus) and protrudes into the antral space. 400x
